title: Latest of Recurring Abandoned (Partially Abandoned) Mall Dreams
content: Just woke up. There was a section of the mall that was still active, some kind of festivities going on. Lots of people. I got on some kind of guided tour ride where we are all crammed into carts like a theme park. At the end the woman next to me says "You don't really seem like you belong here" I Replied "Whys That" She Says "You don't seem like much of an activist" My final response was "To be honest I don't know what all this is" she giggled and that was all that was said. What they were being activists for I'm not sure. The carts arrive at some location in the mall and people disperse. The left path has an escalator that goes up to the second level. The right path stays at the current level. Most the crowd goes right, I go left and up. Next thing I remember I am alone in the mall, walking along the second level. The light is dim. As I walk I pick up on movements in various stores. The first was the store coming up on my left. As I walk up I see through the display glass and catch a crossdressing man learing at me. As I walk by the entrance itself with the crossdressing man maybe 6-10 feet away from me and no barrier between us he quickly skurries into the corner next to the entrance and hides with some level of fear. I remember being annoyed by him and considered throwing a left hook around the corner but didn't. (Note: I immediately connected this character as to some representation of my father after waking) As I walk on I look down to the level below through the open center of the second level. I looked down and saw a woman staring up at me with her mouth wide open in a disturbing way, only to realize that it wasn't a (living) woman but either skin put over a mannequin or a mannequin made out of this woman. No arms or legs just head and torso with the ghoulish expression. The most interesting part to me was what came next, I continued walking and once again looked down to see gorgeous women crawling on a mattress in a mattress store below. Obviously catching my attention I wanted to go down and catch a gander. I found a spot where the store connected to the second level, jumped over a small barrier to get in and found a sharply dressed man holding four(?) separate leashes all connected to the beautiful women. He was sitting on a bench smoking and holding the leashes completely unbothered as the women on the other end were kissing and rubbing each other. From his perspective it was no different than if one was at a dog park with dogs playing with each other. He didn't even notice me as I walked closely by. I remember hoping he doesn't catch me trying to gander at them a bit. &#x200B; The dream at this point shifted to a different scene outside the mall, which I could now see was tucked away in a valley off in some secluded mountains. It continues off into some other unrelated narrative. However this is the fourth abandoned or partially abandoned mall dream I have had In recent time.
